mode.demon_hunt.name: Emergency Call: Demon
mode.demon_hunt.short: Call received: the Demon is "rescuing" people underground again. Stop him while the city holds
mode.demon_hunt.intro: Somewhere under these blocks sleeps the Demon, one of HeroOut's heroes gone mad. Open up the city, prepare your defenders and wake him when you're ready. Not before.
mode.call.name: Emergency Call
mode.call.short: Every shift is a call on one of the heroes gone mad. Stop them while the city holds
mode.call.intro: Emergency call: {hero} is "rescuing" someone again. His lair is somewhere under these blocks. Open up the city, prepare your residents and crack it open when you're ready. Not before.
mode.call.intro_female: Emergency call: {hero} is "rescuing" someone again. Her lair is somewhere under these blocks. Open up the city, prepare your residents and crack it open when you're ready. Not before.
mode.call.optional: Other heroes on the map are optional. Their arms and legs, however, come in very handy.
mode.coop_call.name: Joint Call
mode.coop_call.short: One call for 2–4 players. Everyone gets a Command Center, the hero is shared
mode.quick.name: Lunch Break Call
mode.quick.short: Five minutes, a small map, one hero. Done before lunch is over
mode.quick.intro: The call came in on your lunch break. HeroOut regulations don't cancel lunch, so you've got five minutes for everything.
difficulty.title: Difficulty
difficulty.intern.name: Intern
difficulty.intern.desc: Threats grow slowly, no guessing needed. First shift, nobody judges.
difficulty.shift.name: Shift
difficulty.shift.desc: As intended. The board is solvable without guessing, if you think.
difficulty.rush.name: Crunch
difficulty.rush.desc: Threats grow fast, the board can be 50/50. Just like the real HeroOut.
difficulty.rush.locked: Crunch unlocks after your first win on Shift
difficulty.rush.unlocked: Crunch unlocked. HeroOut thanks you for your overtime.
rank.champion.desc: Three or four trophies. The kind they put on billboards.
rank.legend.desc: Every slot holds a trophy. Control itself would love to put this one back in the warehouse.
rank.r1.desc: Listed in the database as "expendable enthusiasm". Works for experience. Experience is paid on Fridays.
rank.r2.desc: Answers calls. Their own too, but only off the clock.
rank.r3.desc: Gets a helmet. Issued on signature, returned to the warehouse along with the head.
rank.r4.desc: May rescue without prior approval. Once per shift.
rank.r5.desc: Responsible for everyone. Especially when something goes wrong.
rank.r6.desc: Got an office with a view of the Dome. The windows don't open. The view is company property too.
rank.r7.desc: Your face on billboards. The rights to your face belong to HeroOut.
rank.title: Rank
rank.max: Only the 42nd floor is higher. Nobody gets promoted there. They get summoned.
rank.unlocks_none: A badge and a frame. And the envy of the whole department
status.splice_shield.name: Splice Shield
status.splice_shield.desc: The gel tanks one team: the infected takes half damage from a single player's heroes. Hit it together.
status.teamwork.name: Teamwork
status.teamwork.desc: Heroes of two players hit the same target: +20% damage for all.
ally.beacon.bio: Missing-persons searcher, Beacon service. Found people in tunnels by their breathing alone. Nearly two meters tall, so she sees everything and tells everyone about it.
ally.beacon.desc: Now she finds danger, not you: once a minute reveals the numbers of a 3×3 area at the dig edge.
ally.canopy.bio: Greened the rooftops of Lumen City for forty years, long before HeroOut. The company hired her "as the face of the ads" and issued her gardening drones. Her tomatoes still grow on three skyscrapers.
ally.canopy.desc: Granny is planting what's needed again: Microreactors and digging yield 25% more Energy.
ally.current.bio: Coast guard water rescuer. Pulled more people out of the bay than anyone in the city's history. Can't rest: on vacation he rescued ducks.
ally.current.desc: While on shift, washes burns, poison and cold off heroes and walks on water.
ally.demon.bio: Underground rescuer: subway, mines, the hot pipes of Undersun Works. Four arms to hold up the ceiling and pull people out at the same time. Hasn't seen the sun in twenty years because he was always rescuing someone down below.
ally.demon.desc: Up top, he's finally not afraid: heroes dig 30% faster, and the Demon himself drills a block in 2 seconds.
ally.doctor.bio: Neural interface specialist, Seventy-Three's first body. Knows more about Splice gel than anyone, because he signed the reports nobody read.
ally.doctor.desc: Medicine as prescribed again: every 90 seconds revives a knocked-out hero, and a new part fully heals the hero.
ally.frostline.bio: Cryogel medic-rescuer. First in at every fire, last one out. Carries two gel tanks and a thermos of tea she's never once been allowed to finish.
ally.frostline.desc: Now she only puts out enemies: all enemies near her are slowed.
ally.hive.bio: City monitoring operator. Hundreds of bee drones watched traffic jams, fires and linden blossoms. The corporation rewrote their task to "rule breakers".
ally.hive.desc: The swarm now watches enemies: once a minute it marks one hidden nest or lair.
ally.kiln.bio: Heavy fire-and-rescue operator. The biggest and kindest guy in the station. Carried people out of fires in his arms, then made them tea. Calls his ceramic arm "Auntie Clay".
ally.kiln.desc: Carries everything on his back again: heroes near Kiln take 20% less damage.
ally.label: Ally
ally.line.beacon.1: It's empty over there, safe to dig. Honestly.
ally.line.beacon.2: Signal's clean. I see no danger. But I'm watching.
ally.line.canopy.1: I planted a little shrub by the reactor. More Energy, you'll see.
ally.line.canopy.2: No swearing in front of the plants. They hear everything.
ally.line.current.1: Water's warm, burns are gone, poison's rinsed off. Back to the fight.
ally.line.current.2: I'm on dry land. Weird feeling.
ally.line.demon.1: Dig? I dig. Stand clear of the drill.
ally.line.demon.2: It's bright here. I like it. Don't tell anyone.
ally.line.doctor.1: Get up. You're not dead. I forbid it.
ally.line.doctor.2: The new arm took perfectly. Don't thank me. Just don't lose it.
ally.line.frostline.1: Enemies slowed. They're cold. I don't mind.
ally.line.frostline.2: Can I have tea now? Hot. Yes, I know.
ally.line.hive.1: The swarm found a nest. Over there. Bzzz.
ally.line.hive.2: The bees are on your side. Honey comes later.
ally.line.kiln.2: I'll carry you out. But only the ones who need it now.
ally.line.lineman.1: Got him! Hit him while I hold him!
ally.line.lineman.2: Harness checked. For real this time.
ally.line.mason.1: Reinforced your houses. With doors this time.
ally.line.n73.1: Your nerves are fine. I checked. Don't ask how.
ally.line.n73.2: The adaptant on the left is ours now. He doesn't know yet.
ally.line.patch.1: Woof! (Found Energy! Bringing it! Not eating it!)
ally.line.seraph.1: Don't stand in the fire. I can't heal you and your philosophy.
ally.line.seraph.2: The halo's on your side. Finally.
ally.line.standard.1: I'm Standard. Just Standard. But I try.
ally.line.standard.2: Another shift? I'm the backup. I'm always on standby.
ally.line.sweep.1: It's clean here. Safe to stand.
ally.line.sweep.2: Spare parts? Hand them over, I'll dispose of them properly.
ally.lineman.bio: High-rise lineman, power-line rescuer. Once hung from a cable over the monorail for six hours, holding a child and a sandwich. Saved the sandwich too.
ally.lineman.desc: Now he secures enemies, very tightly: pulls them to heroes, and hits near him deal shock.
ally.mason.bio: Geotechnician who shored up supports after earthquakes and rubble clearing. Says every disaster is just a badly calculated load.
ally.mason.desc: Reinforces what needs it: buildings 50% sturdier, rubble cleared twice as fast.
ally.n73.bio: HeroOut's experimental neural circuit, a fighting-game hero. The seventy-two circuits before him didn't survive. He can live in any body and is looking for where the body ends and he begins.
ally.n73.desc: Found which side he's on: all heroes attack 20% faster, and every 30 seconds he lures an adaptant over.
ally.note: Allies fight on their own and boost the whole shift. They don't take parts from enemies: they have enough of their own.
ally.patch.bio: HeroOut rescue dog with a mechanical hind leg. Found people under rubble. Employee of the Month eleven times running, paid in cookies.
ally.patch.desc: The good boy is home again: Energy orbs fly to the center twice as fast, and digging yields 10% more.
ally.seraph.bio: Aerial rescuer and healer. Plucked people off skyscraper roofs and healed them mid-air. Kids draw her on every fence: wings, halo and a huge smile.
ally.seraph.desc: Now heals her own: heroes near her regain health.
ally.standard.bio: Backup body S-01. HeroOut kept thousands of them in warehouses "just in case". The case came. Now one copy knows it's not just a copy.
ally.standard.desc: Mass production now works for you: heroes clock in 15% faster.
ally.sweep.bio: Chemical service sanitation officer. Scrubbed the city after factory accidents. The only one who read the labels on every HeroOut canister, so he knows the gel wasn't only medicinal.
ally.sweep.desc: Cleans for real now: nearby heroes ignore scorched ground and poison, and spare parts recycle for double.
unlock.beacon: Win without opening a nest by accident
unlock.beacon.line: I was shouting where you were hiding? To everyone? Oh God. Fine, now I'll shout where not to go.
unlock.canopy.line: Goodness, what have I done. Have you eaten? Let me at least plant you a garden bed. A normal one.
unlock.current.line: Sorry, was I drowning all of you? I thought you were drowning. Now I think it was me.
unlock.demon.line: Up here… it really isn't that scary. I'll come up. Just not all of you at once, please.
unlock.doctor: Give one hero four trophies at once
unlock.doctor.line: You all have someone else's arms. Was that me? That was me. Fine, then at least I'll make sure they take properly.
unlock.frostline.line: I froze the reactor? Sorry. It was warm. It seemed logical.
unlock.hive.line: Swarm disconnected from Control. Bzzz. We're just bees again. Me too.
unlock.kiln.line: Where's the fire? There was no fire? Then why did I… Never mind. Who needs covering now?
unlock.lineman: Trigger the Conductive Chain reaction 50 times
unlock.lineman.line: Untie me, please. No, wait, I've got it. I'm a lineman.
unlock.mason.line: Why did I wall you in? Good question. Let me build something with doors instead.
unlock.n73.line: I'm not an asset. I'm not a copy. I'm Seventy-Three. And now I choose whose shift I'm on.
unlock.patch.line: Woof! (Sorry. I thought it was a game. It was not a game.)
unlock.screen.text: A full pre-outbreak copy of {hero} was found. Replacements now clock in on your shift with no limits.
unlock.screen.text_female: A full pre-outbreak copy of {hero} was found. Replacements now clock in on your shift with no limits.
unlock.screen.title: Backup restored
unlock.seraph: Win without losing a single hero
unlock.seraph.line: I was healing the nests? I was healing the nests. Never again. Let me heal you instead.
unlock.standard.line: We… I? I. I think I have a name. I just don't remember which.
unlock.sweep.line: I disinfected you? All of you? Well… at least it's clean. Sorry.
heroes.title: HeroOut Heroes
score.name: Shift score
results.score.title: Shift score
results.score.loss_note: Points count even without a win. HeroOut values effort. It only pays for results.
results.rank.title: Rank
results.progress.title: Closest to returning
results.control_win.1: Incident closed. The bill for the rescue has been sent to the victims.
results.control_win.2: Call closed. Gratitude has been expressed verbally. The bonus will be verbal too.
results.control_win.3: Infected neutralized. Its arm is now your hero's property. Your hero, in turn, is HeroOut property.
results.control_lose.1: Command Center lost. The cost has been deducted from the heroes' salaries.
results.control_lose.2: Shift ended early. Overtime is unpaid. So is undertime.
results.control_lose.3: Heroes have scattered across the city. Please return to the warehouse for the next shift.
dossier.title: Dossier
dossier.hero.unknown.desc: Not met yet. According to Control, no such employee ever existed.
dossier.slots: Team slots: {value}. Next one when {need} return
dossier.stat.lost.note: Control wrote them off as inventory wear and tear.
dossier.records.none: None yet. Records start from zero too
dossier.file.standard.1: Model: backup body S-01. Warehouse No. 4, "just in case" shelf.
dossier.file.standard.2: Incident: got up without a call and clocked in as a trio.
dossier.file.standard.3: Control's note: leaving the warehouse without permission counts as theft. Of themselves.
dossier.file.patch.2: Employee of the Month eleven times running. The twelfth was canceled due to mutiny.
dossier.file.patch.3: Control's note: the asset bites. The asset has a point.
dossier.file.canopy.1: Experience: forty years of rooftop gardening, two of them at HeroOut "as the face of the ads".
dossier.file.canopy.2: Incident: greened an avenue, six cars and one inspector.
dossier.file.canopy.3: Control's note: the inspector is in bloom. No complaints filed.
dossier.file.current.1: Position: coastal rescuer. Most people saved in the city's history.
dossier.file.current.2: Incident: started making people drown himself so there'd be someone to save.
dossier.file.current.3: Control's note: rescue quota exceeded by 300%. Bonus awarded.
dossier.file.lineman.1: Position: high-rise lineman. Hung from a cable for six hours with a child and a sandwich.
dossier.file.lineman.2: Incident: ties citizens to utility poles "so they don't fall".
dossier.file.lineman.3: Control's note: zero falls in the district. Excellent metric.
dossier.file.frostline.1: Position: cryogel medic-rescuer. First in at a fire, last one out.
dossier.file.frostline.2: Incident: puts out anything warm, including microreactors and tea.
dossier.file.frostline.3: Control's note: no fire detected. Recommendation: extinguish just in case.
dossier.file.mason.1: Position: geotechnician. Believes every disaster is just a badly calculated load.
dossier.file.mason.2: Incident: walled up a residential block "so it wouldn't collapse". It didn't.
dossier.file.mason.3: Control's note: residents inside are safe. An exit was not in the budget.
dossier.file.sweep.1: Position: chemical sanitation officer. The only one who read the labels on the canisters.
dossier.file.sweep.2: Incident: disinfects residents. Thoroughly. Inside and out.
dossier.file.sweep.3: Control's note: what exactly he read is classified.
dossier.file.beacon.1: Position: missing-persons search. Finds people by their breathing alone.
dossier.file.beacon.2: Incident: shines a searchlight and announces the coordinates of everyone she sees.
dossier.file.beacon.3: Control's note: there are no more missing persons in the city. No hidden ones either.
dossier.file.hive.1: Position: city monitoring. Hundreds of bee drones, traffic jams, fires, linden blossoms.
dossier.file.hive.2: Incident: task rewritten to "rule breakers". Everyone is now a rule breaker.
dossier.file.hive.3: Control's note: the honey is still excellent.
dossier.file.kiln.1: Position: heavy fire-rescue operator. Kindest guy in the station.
dossier.file.kiln.2: Incident: carries people out of fires by smashing through walls. There is no fire.
dossier.file.kiln.3: Control's note: the walls were insured. The people were not.
dossier.file.seraph.1: Position: aerial rescuer and healer. Kids draw her on fences.
dossier.file.seraph.2: Incident: heals everyone, enemies included. Airlifts residents "to the hospital".
dossier.file.seraph.3: Control's note: the hospital is full. A second one is being built at the patients' expense.
dossier.file.doctor.1: Position: neural interface specialist. Signed gel reports nobody read.
dossier.file.doctor.2: Incident: "operates" on anyone in reach and hands out other people's limbs.
dossier.file.doctor.3: Control's note: the reports have been read. The reports have been destroyed.
dossier.file.demon.1: Position: Undersun Works underground rescuer. Hasn't seen the sun in twenty years.
dossier.file.demon.3: Control's note: it really is safe down there. Nobody is let back up.
dossier.file.n73.1: Model: experimental neural circuit No. 73. The previous seventy-two were written off.
dossier.file.n73.2: Incident: switches bodies in search of himself.
dossier.file.n73.3: Control's note: employees are forbidden to find themselves. He's already been found. He's on the balance sheet.
challenge.win_without_accidental_open: win without opening a nest by accident
daily.name: Daily Call
daily.short: One map for the whole city. Your first finished attempt counts
daily.done: Counted: {value} pts. Play on for fun
daily.streak_lost: Streak broken. Control has logged an absence.
boon.energy_cache.name: Stash
boon.energy_cache.line: Someone in HeroOut accounting is in for a surprise.
boon.reactor_overclock.name: Reactor Overclock
boon.reactor_overclock.desc: Microreactors yield 30% more Energy. Can be taken twice.
boon.reactor_overclock.line: The manual forbids it. The manual stayed in the cache.
boon.sharp_shovels.name: Sharpened Shovels
boon.sharp_shovels.line: The shovels were written off. Nobody told the shovels.
boon.reinforcements.name: Reinforcements
boon.reinforcements.desc: +2 shift slots. Can be taken twice.
boon.reinforcements.line: Found in the supply closet. Waiting for a shift since last Tuesday.
boon.field_training.name: Field Training
boon.field_training.desc: All heroes trained one level higher, no School needed. Max level 3.
boon.field_training.line: Video course "How Not to Die", four minutes. Three of them are ads.
boon.armor_plates.name: Body Armor
boon.armor_plates.desc: +2 defense to all heroes. Can be taken twice.
boon.armor_plates.line: One size fits all. Pinches everyone equally.
boon.first_aid.name: First Aid Kits
boon.first_aid.desc: Heroes out of combat regain 1 health per second.
boon.first_aid.line: Bandages, plasters and not a drop of gel. That's why they work.
boon.nest_tracker.name: Tip-off
boon.nest_tracker.desc: Reveals the nearest hidden nest or hero lair.
boon.nest_tracker.line: Anonymous call. The voice was suspiciously loud. Very Beacon.
boon.spare_part.name: Warehouse Spare
boon.spare_part.desc: A level 2 part for the hero with the most empty slots.
boon.weak_spot.name: Target Dossier
boon.weak_spot.desc: +25% damage to the call target, its weakness revealed in advance.
boon.weak_spot.line: From the hero's personnel file. The personnel file was company property too.
boon.hotline.name: Hotline
boon.hotline.desc: Heroes clock in 20% faster. Can be taken twice.
boon.hotline.line: The line was rerouted from Sales. Sales dropped. Rescues went up.
boon.pick.title: HeroOut cache: take one
boon.pick.hint: The rest goes back to the warehouse, per inventory
role.scout.name: Scout
role.scout.desc: Digs 30% faster, everyone sees their marks. Hero damage −15%.
role.scout.line: Sees everything. Says some of it. You do the talking.
role.assault.name: Assault
role.assault.desc: Heroes hit 25% harder, +10 health. Dig 25% slower.
role.assault.line: Solves problems by hand. Their own and trophy ones.
role.support.name: Support
role.support.desc: 50% more Energy, buildings 20% cheaper, Medcenter heals the whole team. Hero damage −15%.
role.support.line: Without Support, Assault is just a guy with a heavy arm.
role.engineer.name: Engineer
role.engineer.desc: Buildings 50% sturdier, rubble cleared twice as fast, repairs allies' buildings. Hero damage −10%.
role.engineer.line: Fixes everything the others broke. Plans included.
role.pick.title: Choose a role
enemy.adaptant.desc: A city resident infected by Splice gel. Grew a stranger's body part and can't stop. In a fight, residents take these parts as trophies.
enemy.heavy_adaptant.desc: A former construction-machinery operator with ceramic armor and piston legs. Slow, but hits buildings.
enemy.patch.desc: A rescue dog with a mechanical paw. Brings people to its owners. Any people, really.
enemy.canopy.desc: An elderly city gardener in green. Spent her life greening rooftops; now she greens everything else.
enemy.current.desc: A water rescue worker. 'Saving the drowning': washes people into the bay with a water cannon.
enemy.lineman.desc: A high-rise rigger. Still belaying: ties people to poles with cable, 'so they don't fall'.
enemy.frostline.desc: A cryogel medic-rescuer. Still putting out fires: drenches everything warm with gel, microreactors included.
enemy.mason.desc: A geotechnician. Reinforces everything: puts beams across streets and walls up doors, 'so it won't collapse'.
enemy.sweep.desc: A sanitation worker in a hazmat suit. Disinfects everything, residents especially.
enemy.beacon.desc: A lost-persons searcher. Finds everyone: shines a spotlight and loudly announces where each person is.
enemy.hive.desc: Drone-bee city monitoring. Watches everyone and stings 'quarantine violators'.
enemy.kiln.desc: A heavy fire-rescue worker. Still hauling people out of fires: grabs residents and carries them off.
enemy.seraph.desc: An aerial rescuer and healer. Still healing: her halo drone fixes enemies nearby. Take her out first.
enemy.doctor.desc: A neural-interface specialist. 'Operating' on everyone: injects gel into enemies and hands out strength.
enemy.demon.desc: An underground HeroOut rescuer, one of the crazed heroes. Leads people down, 'into the bunkers', straight into the drill heat.
enemy.n73.desc: An experimental HeroOut neurolink. Swaps bodies searching for itself. Control says this model never existed.
rescue.name: Restore Center
rescue.desc: Bring 3 heroes to the ruins and hold for 10 s. The Center returns at 40% integrity.
rescue.done: Center raised! {player} is back on shift.
rescue.spectator: The center wasn't raised. You're watching the rest of the shift from the sidelines.
transfer.name: Send Energy
challenge.win_no_hero_lost: win without losing a single hero
challenge.hero_full_trophies: give one hero four trophies at once
building.home.name: Hero Dorm
building.home.desc: Triple bunks and a shower schedule. Prints heroes up to level 2 and adds +1 shift slot.
building.birth.title: Who clocks in next
building.birth.auto.desc: Sends whoever's element is strongest against the nearest enemy.
building.birth.not_unlocked: Not on your side yet. To unlock: {condition}
building.birth.cap_full: No slots. Build a Hero Dorm
status.stump.name: Stump
status.stump.hint: Take a part for this slot from an enemy, or let the Medcenter regrow it.
unit.resident.name: Hero
resource.residents.name: Heroes
unit.resident_born: A new hero is on shift
cell.mark.hint: Hold a closed block to mark it "Danger" or "Not sure". Swipes skip marked blocks.
boon.peek_numbers.name: Recon Drone
boon.peek_numbers.desc: Pick a block: the drone reveals the numbers of every block in the 3×3 around it.
boon.peek_numbers.line: The drone declined insurance and took off on its own.
site.warehouse.name: Control Warehouse
site.warehouse.desc: Control stores citizens here as company property. Break it open and they run for the Command Center.
site.warehouse.found: Warehouse opened: citizens are running for the Center
site.hostages: Hostages at the nest. Open it and they run for the Center
unit.civilian.name: Citizen
unit.civilian.desc: Doesn't fight, runs fast. Cover them on the way to the Center.
unit.civilian.hiding: A citizen is hiding: dig a path to them
building.outpost.name: Checkpoint
building.outpost.desc: A former HeroOut checkpoint. The turnstile's broken and the land around it is yours now. Edge of your land only.
building.relay.name: Relay
building.relay.desc: Picks up shift rosters from other districts: +1 hero slot above the norm. Pings visible across the map. Control calls this overtime.
building.watchtower.name: Watchtower
building.watchtower.desc: This HeroOut monitoring tower used to watch you. Now every 90 s it reveals the numbers of a nearby 3×3. The thinking is still yours.
building.jammer.name: Splice Jammer
building.jammer.desc: Scrambles the gel's signal. Nearby infected move slower, hit less often, no elements or abilities. Unlocks after your first destroyed nest.
building.backup_lab.name: Backup Archive
building.backup_lab.desc: A server room of nightly copies of everyone who ever wore a HeroOut suit. Replacements print 20% faster. If the Archive stands at shift end, hero unlock progress ×1.5.
building.rotation_center.name: Limb Rotation Center
building.rotation_center.desc: Corporate program "Lend a Hand". Nearby heroes swap trophies. Needs 2 Rescue Schools.
build.requires.nest: Destroy at least one nest first
rotation.title: Limb Rotation
rotation.empty: No one nearby. Bring heroes within 2 blocks of the Center
rotation.hint: Drag a trophy onto another hero, or onto a same-slot trophy to swap
site.survivor.name: Control Warehouse
site.survivor.desc: Control stores citizens here as company property. Break it open and they run for the Command Center.
site.survivor.found: Warehouse opened: citizens are running for the Center
lose.text: The base has fallen. Heroes scattered across the city, but replacements will clock in next shift.
building.station.name: Station: {hero}
building.station.desc: A {hero} service post. Dispatches only this hero. The higher the hero's level, the pricier the station.
squad.title: Shift Briefing
squad.slot_next: One more slot after {need} unlocked heroes
squad.max_high: No more than two level 3–4 heroes per squad
squad.auto.desc: Picks heroes whose element hits the enemies' weaknesses
squad.taken.desc: This shift the service is infected and plays against you
squad.resting.desc: Off shift. HeroOut doesn't pay for leave, but allows it
squad.locked: Service not on your side yet
building.station.standard.name: Serial Chassis Depot
building.station.patch.name: Patch's Kennel
building.station.canopy.name: Gardener's Greenhouse
building.station.current.name: Current's Lifeguard Tower
building.station.lineman.name: Lineman's Pylon
building.station.frostline.name: Frostline's Cryo Station
building.station.mason.name: Mason's Concrete Yard
building.station.sweep.name: Sweep's Decon Post
building.station.beacon.name: Beacon's Searchlight Post
building.station.hive.name: Hive's Apiary
building.station.kiln.name: Kiln's Fire Station
building.station.seraph.name: Seraph's Helipad
building.station.doctor.name: Doctor's Clinic
building.station.demon.name: Demon's Mine Shaft
building.station.n73.name: Lab N-73
hero.copy.desc: Printed from a HeroOut backup taken before the outbreak. No gel: sane, but weaker than the original.
hero.infected.desc: A living suit wearer. Splice gel made them stronger and madder.
unit.resident.desc: Our replacement: a pre-outbreak hero copy, no gel. Digs, builds and fights. Takes parts from the infected it beats.
backup.draft.desc: Half-assembled copy: no ability, health 50%, damage 70%. Only one draft per squad.
backup.draft.limit: Only one draft backup per squad
backup.restored.desc: Ability works. The higher the sync, the stronger the hero.
sync.label: Sync {value}/5
sync.hint: Grows over shifts with this hero: being in the squad, trophies, beating infected of the same service, and shift wins.
sync.max: Full sync. This is as strong as it gets without gel.
card.subtitle: Replacement · pre-outbreak backup
card.ability_off: Ability disabled in a draft backup
mutation.title: Mutation
mutation.label: Mutation: {part}
building.forge.name: Element Forge
building.forge.desc: Recolors a nearby hero's trophy into another element: same power, same slot. 40 Energy, once a minute. HeroOut's branding department is horrified.
building.civ_shelter.name: Citizen Shelter
building.civ_shelter.desc: Rescued citizens live here, up to five per Shelter, each giving 1 Energy every 5 s. Here they're not property. Yet.
building.repair.name: Repair Crew
building.repair.desc: Repairs nearby buildings and rebuilds ruins twice as fast. The only service in the city that fixes instead of rescues.
recolor.title: Trophy Recolor
recolor.same: The trophy is already that element
recolor.empty: No heroes with trophies nearby. Bring them within 2 blocks
cell.mark.confirm: Your mark "{mark}". Tap again to clear it and open the block.
site.blueprint.name: Blueprint Fragment
site.blueprint.desc: A scrap of blueprint from the HeroOut archive. Kept between shifts, even if the shift fails.
site.blueprint.done: Blueprint complete: {building} can now be built
site.armor_crate.name: Armor Plate Crate
site.armor_crate.desc: Decommissioned HeroOut armor plates. Go to nearby heroes, those with fewer first.
site.lore_record.name: Control Record
site.lore_record.desc: A HeroOut document someone forgot to shred. Goes to the Dossier, Archive tab.
dossier.archive.locked: Record not found. Look for the blue folder on the sensor.
archive.1.title: About the Cat
archive.1.text: The cat in the tree on Sunny Street has been logged for the 412th time. The cat is now on the books as a reusable incident. So is the tree. Rescue no more than once a week so as not to devalue the service.
archive.2.title: Notice to Dome Residents
archive.2.text: Dear residents! Starting Monday, the sky over the Dome is subscription-based. Rain is included in the Plus plan. Sun is in Premium. Darkness is free, for now.
archive.3.title: Crane No. 14
archive.3.text: — Crane No. 14 goes crazy at 9:14, the patrol passes at 9:15. Please don't mix up the times, last time we rescued the wrong people. — Noted. Suggest running the "Cranes Are Safe" ad at 9:13.
archive.4.title: Protocol EVERYONE IS ON CALL
archive.4.text: Clause 1. Every citizen is a HeroOut on-call employee. Clause 2. An on-call employee may not decline duty. Clause 3. Clauses 1 and 2 take effect immediately and retroactively.
archive.5.title: Splice Gel: Marketing Report
archive.5.text: The gel regrows lost limbs. Sometimes someone else's. Sometimes extra ones. Proposed slogan: "Sometimes it's a bonus." Safety objects. Safety has been moved to the warehouse.
archive.6.title: Memo to Replacements
archive.6.text: You are not the original. The original is busy or infected. Do not look for them, do not talk to them, and do not take their limbs without a waybill. Your memory is company property; handle with care.
archive.7.title: Citizen Storage Rules
archive.7.text: Store citizens at +18°C, in a dry place, this side up. Talking on shelves is prohibited, except "thank you, HeroOut". Escaping the warehouse counts as damage to property.
archive.8.title: Reply from the 42nd Floor
archive.8.text: — Is the shift over? — The shift never ends. — Then when do employees rest? — Rest is included in the Premium plan. Employees are on Basic.
archive.9.title: Underground Department
archive.9.text: The underground rescuer exceeded the downward evacuation plan by 400%. No upward evacuation plan was ever issued. Recommendation: issue one. Downward.
archive.10.title: S-01 Inventory
archive.10.text: There were 1,200 S-01 reserve bodies. By morning there were 1,197. By afternoon three came back and brought three more, identical. Recount suspended: the bodies ask not to be numbered.
